cves.d: A security flaw has been discovered in JeecgBoot 3.9.5. This affects an unknown part of the file /jeecg-boot/drag/onlDragDatasetHead/getAllChartData of the component JimuBI. Performing a manipulation of the argument params results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

IBM TRIRIGA Application Platform 5.0.0 through 5.0.9 IBM TRIRIGA could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command.
IBM Qiskit SDK 1.4.2 through 2.6.2 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to deserialization of untrusted data.
IBM Qiskit SDK 2.4.0 through 2.6.1 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an out-of-bounds write caused by improper input validation when accessing a corrupted unitary matrix.
IBM SevOne Network Performance Management 7.0.0 through 8.2.2 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to a buffer overflow.

A vulnerability was determined in floci-io Floci up to 2.4.0. Impacted is the function BuildspecParser.parseArtifacts of the file src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/codebuild/CodeBuildJsonHandler.java of the component Artifact Handler. This manipulation of the argument buildspecOverride.artifacts.base-directory causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was found in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.32.4/3.33.0/3.34.0-rc3/4.0.0-alpha.1. This issue affects the function WorkflowSystemTask.start of the file PlannerContextFetchTask.java of the component PLANNER_CONTEXT_FETCH Task Handler. The manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

A vulnerability has been found in Dianping CAT 3.0.0/3.1.0/4.0-RC1. This vulnerability affects the function Model.getDomain of the file WEB-INF/tags/hourlyReport.tag of the component Report Handler. The manipulation of the argument domain leads to cross site scripting. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge 4.0.0 through 5.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to a use-after-free vulnerability.

A vulnerability was detected in erupts erupt up to 2.3.0. Affected by this issue is the function ReportService.queryBiData of the file ReportService.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument sort results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.4.0 can resolve this issue. The patch is named 8d2eaffc79b977c9d11222b9d435a002dceaa062. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

ai.summary_en: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight widespread critical risks across web security, cloud infrastructure, and IoT ecosystems, characterized primarily by remote code execution and authentication bypasses. Notable incidents include privilege escalation flaws in Kubernetes controllers such as Kyverno and Kubero, unauthenticated RCE in consumer networking hardware from vendors like TOTOLINK and Linksys, and injection attacks targeting identity platforms including Keycloak and IBM MQ. Furthermore, significant deserialization vulnerabilities and supply chain risks were detected in middleware and development tools, emphasizing persistent threats to data integrity and system access controls.
ai.summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞凸显了Web安全、云基础设施及物联网生态系统中广泛存在的严重风险，主要特征为远程代码执行与身份验证绕过。典型案例包括Kyverno和Kubero等Kubernetes控制器中的提权漏洞、TOTOLINK和Linksys等厂商消费级网络设备中的未认证远程代码执行漏洞，以及针对Keycloak和IBM MQ等身份平台的注入攻击。此外，中间件与开发工具中发现的重大反序列化漏洞及供应链风险，进一步强调了对数据完整性与系统访问控制的持续威胁。

items.reason_en: JupyterLab Desktop inserts unencoded remote-server URLs into the welcome view, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the user's browser context.
items.reason_zh: JupyterLab Desktop 在欢迎界面中插入未编码的远程服务器 URL，攻击者可借此在用户浏览器上下文中执行任意 JavaScript。

items.reason_en: OpenHuman agent harness allows external channels to trigger persistent shell cron jobs without human approval, enabling unauthorized system execution on research workstations.
items.reason_zh: OpenHuman 代理框架允许外部通道触发持久化 Shell cron 任务而无需人工审批，从而在研究工作站上实现未经授权的系统执行。

items.reason_en: VeraCrypt accepts untrusted length and count values during deserialization, potentially allowing attackers to cross memory boundaries and compromise disk encryption integrity.
items.reason_zh: VeraCrypt 在反序列化过程中接受不受信任的长度和计数值，可能导致攻击者跨越内存边界并破坏磁盘加密完整性。

items.reason_en: The OpenSSL library bundled with Illumio VEN for Windows suffers from an uncontrolled search path flaw, enabling low-privileged users to escalate to SYSTEM privileges.
items.reason_zh: 随 Windows 版 Illumio VEN 捆绑的 OpenSSL 库存在不受控制的搜索路径漏洞，使低权限用户能够提权至 SYSTEM 权限。

items.reason_en: Insecure default configuration assigns elevated privileges with a predictable password to the built-in installation account, enabling unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: 不安全的默认配置将提升的权限与可预测的密码分配给内置安装账户，导致未授权访问。

items.reason_en: The automatic crash reporting pipeline executes attacker-controlled binaries as root, allowing unprivileged local attackers to escalate privileges on Linux systems.
items.reason_zh: 自动崩溃报告流程会以 root 身份执行攻击者控制的二进制文件，使无特权的本地攻击者能够在 Linux 系统上提权。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated Java RMI service allows credential theft and arbitrary SQL execution, posing a critical risk to desktop application data integrity.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的 Java RMI 服务可导致凭证窃取和任意 SQL 执行，对桌面应用程序的数据完整性构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Wildcard CORS on an unauthenticated local file server enables malicious websites to read or overwrite critical installation files on localhost.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的本地文件服务器上的通配符 CORS 策略可使恶意网站读取或覆盖本地主机上的关键安装文件。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution via malicious Git clean or process filter drivers allows attackers to execute commands simply by opening a crafted repository.
items.reason_zh: 通过恶意的 Git clean 或进程过滤驱动程序可实现远程代码执行，攻击者仅需打开一个精心构造的仓库即可执行命令。

items.reason_en: Bearer tokens are exposed through persisted logs and debug events in the OpenHuman desktop application, compromising local agent credentials.
items.reason_zh: OpenHuman 桌面应用程序中的持久化日志和调试事件会泄露 Bearer 令牌，从而导致本地代理凭证受损。

items.reason_en: Claude Desktop invokes git.exe via a relative path on Windows, allowing search-path poisoning through malicious executables placed in project directories.
items.reason_zh: Claude Desktop 在 Windows 上通过相对路径调用 git.exe，攻击者可通过在项目目录中放置恶意可执行文件来实施搜索路径污染。

items.reason_en: Local attackers can exploit path traversal in the PackageKit Zypp backend simulation to gain root privileges on the host system.
items.reason_zh: 本地攻击者可利用 PackageKit Zypp 后端模拟中的路径遍历漏洞，在宿主机系统上获取 root 权限。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged users can manipulate the SYSTEM updater service to install attacker-supplied archives into arbitrary directories, escalating privileges.
items.reason_zh: 低权限用户可操纵 SYSTEM 更新器服务，将攻击者提供的归档文件安装到任意目录中，从而实现提权。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in TÜBİTAK Pardus Boot Repair allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands during recovery operations. This compromises Linux desktop boot processes and system integrity.
items.reason_zh: TÜBİTAK Pardus Boot Repair 中存在 OS 命令注入漏洞，攻击者可在恢复操作期间执行任意系统命令，从而破坏 Linux 桌面启动过程与系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Command injection in ZeroTier VPN function executes with root privileges when input validation is bypassed. This threatens secure overlay networking tools commonly deployed on workstations and servers.
items.reason_zh: 当绕过输入验证时，ZeroTier VPN 功能中的命令注入将以 root 权限执行，这对常部署于工作站和服务器的安全覆盖网络工具构成威胁。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in labbench passes arbitrary .pickle files to pandas.read_pickle without validation. Crafted data archives enable remote code execution in data science desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: labbench 对不受信任数据进行反序列化时，会将任意 .pickle 文件直接传递给 pandas.read_pickle 且不做验证。精心构造的数据归档可在数据科学桌面环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in BabelDOC allows attackers to spike CPU and memory usage via unbounded bfrange and cidrange spans in PDFs. This impacts local AI document processing applications running on desktops.
items.reason_zh: BabelDOC 存在资源耗尽漏洞，攻击者可通过 PDF 中无界的 bfrange 和 cidrange 跨度导致 CPU 和内存使用率飙升，进而影响在桌面上运行的本地 AI 文档处理应用。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in OtterMind Chat2DB's class generator results from unsanitized tableName arguments. Attackers can traverse directories to read or modify local files in database GUI clients.
items.reason_zh: OtterMind Chat2DB 类生成器中的路径遍历漏洞源于未清理的 tableName 参数。攻击者可利用该漏洞遍历目录，在数据库 GUI 客户端中读取或修改本地文件。

items.reason_en: IPC record-separator injection in Telegram Desktop enables remote attackers to upload local files via crafted tg:// links. This flaw compromises desktop client isolation and privacy controls.
items.reason_zh: Telegram Desktop 中的 IPC 记录分隔符注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够通过精心构造的 tg:// 链接上传本地文件，从而破坏桌面客户端的隔离机制与隐私控制。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on Logseq's local HTTP API exposes sensitive user data to remote attackers. The vulnerability undermines local-first security assumptions in modern desktop note-taking applications.
items.reason_zh: Logseq 的本地 HTTP API 缺少认证机制，导致敏感用户数据向远程攻击者暴露。该漏洞破坏了现代桌面笔记应用中“本地优先”的安全假设。

items.reason_en: Broken access control grants temporary AWS credentials to any authenticated user, enabling unauthorized enumeration and reading of shared cloud storage buckets.
items.reason_zh: 失效的访问控制机制向任何已认证用户授予临时 AWS 凭证，导致攻击者能够未授权地枚举和读取共享云存储桶。

items.reason_en: Insecure TLS validation trusts all certificates and ignores hostname verification, allowing network attackers to intercept and modify sensitive mobile app traffic.
items.reason_zh: 不安全的 TLS 验证机制信任所有证书并忽略主机名验证，使网络攻击者能够拦截和修改敏感移动应用流量。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded MQTT credentials enable authenticated attackers to connect to brokers and access data across tenant boundaries, compromising multi-tenant mobile deployments.
items.reason_zh: 硬编码的 MQTT 凭证使已认证的攻击者能够连接至 Broker 并跨租户边界访问数据，从而危及多租户移动部署的安全性。

items.reason_en: Tasmota firmware contains a heap out-of-bounds write in device group messaging, allowing unauthenticated LAN attackers to corrupt memory and execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: Tasmota 固件的设备组消息传递功能中存在堆越界写入漏洞，使未认证的局域网攻击者能够破坏内存并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Hisense VIDAA Smart TV exposes an unauthenticated Google Cobalt WebDriver automation server on port 4444, granting full browser control to any LAN-connected attacker.
items.reason_zh: Hisense VIDAA 智能电视在 4444 端口暴露了未认证的 Google Cobalt WebDriver 自动化服务器，使任何局域网连接的攻击者都能获得完整的浏览器控制权。

items.reason_en: Zephyr RTOS lacks proper user-supplied pointer validation in RTIO syscalls, creating a direct path for local privilege escalation or kernel crashes in embedded systems.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS 在 RTIO 系统调用中缺乏对用户传入指针的适当验证，为嵌入式系统中的本地提权或内核崩溃提供了直接途径。

items.reason_en: The Zephyr Bluetooth LE Controller fails to validate received PDU lengths against radio programming limits, risking buffer overflows in constrained IoT networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr 蓝牙低功耗控制器未能根据无线电编程限制验证接收到的 PDU 长度，可能在受限的物联网网络协议栈中引发缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Flawed syscall verification in the Zephyr RTOS incorrectly accumulates failure flags, risking local privilege escalation or denial of service in embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS 中有缺陷的系统调用验证逻辑会错误累积失败标志，可能导致嵌入式设备发生本地提权或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Unsafe resource ID handling in Signal K Server's REST API permits path traversal, compromising file system isolation on marine and IoT hub deployments.
items.reason_zh: Signal K Server 的 REST API 在处理资源 ID 时存在安全隐患，允许路径遍历，从而破坏海洋设备及 IoT 集线器部署中的文件系统隔离性。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in DStarGateway APRS utilities can corrupt memory or crash state when processing empty sender fields in amateur radio gateways.
items.reason_zh: DStarGateway APRS 工具在处理业余无线电网关的空发送者字段时可能发生整数下溢，导致内存损坏或状态崩溃。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the router's setup wizard CGI handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the device.
items.reason_zh: 路由器设置向导CGI处理程序中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者以root权限在设备上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Substring-based Referer validation allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass CSRF protections, potentially triggering privileged configuration changes on smart home devices.
items.reason_zh: 基于子串的Referer验证机制允许未认证的攻击者绕过CSRF防护，从而可能在智能家居设备上触发高权限配置更改。

items.reason_en: Routing mismatch between Guice mapping and Jetty ResourceServlet allows unauthenticated attackers to access device-specific media endpoints by guessing unique IDs.
items.reason_zh: Guice映射与Jetty ResourceServlet之间的路由不匹配漏洞允许未认证的攻击者通过猜测唯一ID来访问设备特定的媒体端点。

items.reason_en: Remote OS command injection via ping and traceroute arguments in the Linksys E5350 setup wizard enables complete device compromise.
items.reason_zh: Linksys E5350设置向导中通过ping和traceroute参数触发的远程OS命令注入漏洞可导致设备被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded credentials in the Qihoo 360 Router M5 boot script allow remote attackers to bypass authentication entirely.
items.reason_zh: Qihoo 360 Router M5启动脚本中的硬编码凭据允许远程攻击者完全绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: Improper firmware signature verification in Qihoo 360 routers permits the installation of unsigned or malicious firmware updates.
items.reason_zh: Qihoo 360路由器中固件签名验证机制存在缺陷，允许安装未签名或恶意的固件更新。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK A950RG MAC filter handler allows remote code execution on consumer networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK A950RG MAC过滤处理程序中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在消费级网络设备上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE's WiFi configuration handler is triggered via manipulated KeyStr arguments. The publicly disclosed exploit enables remote code execution on popular home networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE的WiFi配置处理程序中存在可通过篡改KeyStr参数触发的缓冲区溢出漏洞。已公开的漏洞利用代码可在此类主流家用网络硬件上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE's IP QoS rules function allows remote attackers to crash or execute code via crafted ipStart values. Exploit availability increases risk of widespread network takeover.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE的IP QoS规则函数中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过构造的ipStart值导致系统崩溃或执行代码。该漏洞的可利用性增加了大规模网络接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Hisense VIDAA Smart TV's MQTT broker accepts default credentials and lacks rate limiting on pairing PINs. Attackers can brute-force access and remotely control smart display ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Hisense VIDAA智能电视的MQTT代理存在身份验证绕过漏洞，其接受默认凭据且对配对PIN码缺乏速率限制。攻击者可进行暴力破解并远程控制智能显示生态系统。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in D-Link DIR-878's HNAP handler is triggered via ConfigDNS arguments. Public exploit availability allows remote compromise of consumer-grade routers and network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DIR-878的HNAP处理程序中存在可通过ConfigDNS参数触发的缓冲区溢出漏洞。公开可用的漏洞利用代码可导致消费级路由器及网络分段被远程攻破。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Akuvox HyPanel allows remote attackers to bypass login by manipulating the engrmode argument. This exposes smart video intercoms to unauthorized physical and digital access.
items.reason_zh: Akuvox HyPanel的身份验证机制存在缺陷，允许远程攻击者通过操纵engrmode参数绕过登录。这使得智能视频对讲机面临未经授权的物理和数字访问风险。

items.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in the WeChat auth endpoint of Chengdu Feiyuxing IoT gateways allows full device compromise. Attackers can execute arbitrary system commands without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 成都飞鱼星IoT网关的微信认证端点存在远程OS命令注入漏洞，可导致设备被完全接管。攻击者无需认证即可执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the web administration interface of VW2100 devices enables unauthenticated attackers to execute system commands. This directly impacts the security of embedded network hardware.
items.reason_zh: VW2100设备的Web管理界面中存在命令注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者执行系统命令。这直接影响嵌入式网络设备的安全性。

items.reason_en: Kubero allows unauthenticated JWT forgery using a hardcoded fallback secret when environment variables are unset, compromising entire Kubernetes cluster administration.
items.reason_zh: 当环境变量未设置时，Kubero会使用硬编码的备用密钥进行JWT伪造且无需认证，这将危及整个Kubernetes集群的管理安全。

items.reason_en: Red Hat OpenShift bootstrap nodes approve CSRs without identity validation, enabling install-network attackers to forge admin certificates and extract kubeconfig files.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat OpenShift引导节点在未进行身份验证的情况下批准CSR，使得install-network攻击者能够伪造管理员证书并提取kubeconfig文件。

items.reason_en: Cocos AI accepts trusted execution environment attestation evidence without binding it to a unique machine identity, allowing spoofed environments to bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: Cocos AI接受可信执行环境证明证据但未将其绑定到唯一的机器标识，使得伪造环境能够绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: The zizmor CI/CD static analysis tool serializes sensitive GitHub tokens in debug logs, exposing credentials to unauthorized parties in pipeline environments.
items.reason_zh: zizmor CI/CD静态分析工具会将敏感的GitHub令牌序列化至调试日志中，导致流水线环境中的凭据泄露给未授权方。

items.reason_en: Known exploited vulnerability allows authorized users to bypass authorization mechanisms and gain full administrative privileges in IBM Aspera Faspex.
items.reason_zh: IBM Aspera Faspex中存在已知被利用的漏洞，允许授权用户绕过授权机制并获取完整的管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Known exploited flaw treats loopback requests as administrator by default, granting remote attackers unrestricted control over GPU cluster management.
items.reason_zh: 已知被利用的缺陷默认将回环请求视为管理员操作，授予远程攻击者对GPU集群管理的无限制控制权。

items.reason_en: Improper memory remap handling in AWS Firecracker allows guest root users to read or modify VMM process memory on restored microVMs.
items.reason_zh: AWS Firecracker中内存重映射处理机制存在缺陷，允许客户机root用户读取或修改恢复状态microVM上的VMM进程内存。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated gRPC channels deserialize untrusted pickle data in LeRobot, enabling remote code execution in AI inference pipelines.
items.reason_zh: LeRobot中未认证的gRPC通道会反序列化不受信任的pickle数据，从而在AI推理流水线中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation of external resource references in Coupa's document conversion feature enables server-side request forgery attacks against internal networks.
items.reason_zh: Coupa的文档转换功能对外部资源引用的验证不足，可导致针对内部网络的服务端请求伪造(SSRF)攻击。

items.reason_en: Insufficient isolation between execution-capable Docker sandboxes and trusted services allows low-privileged users to escape containers and compromise host infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 具备执行能力的Docker沙箱与受信任服务之间隔离不足，允许低权限用户逃逸容器并破坏主机基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated cluster-network callers are accepted on the gRPC API, bypassing namespace checks and allowing unauthorized Kubernetes resource manipulation.
items.reason_zh: gRPC API接受了未认证的集群网络调用者，绕过了命名空间检查，从而导致未经授权的Kubernetes资源操作。

items.reason_en: Treating empty namespaces as authorization exceptions permits authenticated users to modify or delete shared global pipelines without proper permissions.
items.reason_zh: 将空命名空间视为授权例外的机制允许已认证用户在缺乏适当权限的情况下修改或删除共享全局流水线。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in the VitaFit cloud API allows account takeover via linked social accounts without proof of ownership.
items.reason_zh: VitaFit云API中存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，允许攻击者在无法提供所有权证明的情况下通过关联的社交账号接管账户。

items.reason_en: Kyverno authorization bypass enables namespace tenants to overwrite resources in other namespaces using crafted CEL expressions.
items.reason_zh: Kyverno的授权绕过漏洞使命名空间租户能够通过构造的CEL表达式覆盖其他命名空间中的资源。

items.reason_en: A nil policy context loader in Kyverno's cleanup controller allows namespace admins to escape confinement and modify cluster-scoped resources.
items.reason_zh: Kyverno清理控制器中存在空策略上下文加载器漏洞，允许命名空间管理员突破限制并修改集群作用域资源。

items.reason_en: Cached signature verification keyed by image tag instead of digest skips security checks, enabling malicious container deployments.
items.reason_zh: 以镜像标签而非摘要作为键的缓存签名验证机制会跳过安全检查，从而导致恶意容器得以部署。

items.reason_en: OpenShift Pipelines-as-Code fails to verify creator permissions, allowing namespace users to execute unauthorized PipelineRuns.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift Pipelines-as-Code 未验证创建者权限，允许命名空间用户执行未经授权的 PipelineRun。

items.reason_en: Namespace clamp bypass in Kyverno allows tenants to issue cross-namespace and cluster-scoped API requests via malformed percent-escapes. This breaks Kubernetes multi-tenancy isolation and risks cluster-wide compromise.
items.reason_zh: Kyverno 中的命名空间限制绕过漏洞允许租户通过构造错误的百分号转义序列发起跨命名空间和集群范围的 API 请求。此漏洞破坏了 Kubernetes 的多租户隔离机制，并可能导致整个集群被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in IBM API Connect bypasses destination restrictions, forcing the gateway to fetch responses from unintended internal resources. This exposes sensitive cloud backend data to external actors.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 存在服务端请求伪造漏洞，可绕过目标地址限制，强制网关从非预期的内部资源获取响应。此漏洞会将敏感的云后端数据暴露给外部攻击者。

items.reason_en: Use of a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator in IBM API Connect enables full administrative control. Compromised randomness undermines session tokens and configuration integrity.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 使用了密码学强度不足的伪随机数生成器，可导致完全的管理员控制。随机性被破坏会危及会话令牌和配置完整性。

items.reason_en: Keycloak fails to clear an internal session attribute during client creation with authorization services enabled. This allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate client configurations.
items.reason_zh: 启用授权服务时，Keycloak 在客户端创建过程中未能清除内部会话属性。此漏洞允许已认证的攻击者提升权限并篡改客户端配置。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in OpenRemote lets realm administrators modify global Keycloak URLs without super-admin checks. Attackers can redirect authentication flows to malicious endpoints for credential harvesting.
items.reason_zh: OpenRemote 存在授权不当漏洞，允许领域管理员在未进行超级管理员校验的情况下修改全局 Keycloak URL。攻击者可重定向认证流程至恶意端点以窃取凭证。

items.reason_en: Multiple critical flaws in IBM API Connect allow unauthenticated and authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. These vulnerabilities threaten the integrity of enterprise API management platforms.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 存在多个关键缺陷，允许未认证和已认证的远程攻击者执行任意代码。这些漏洞威胁企业 API 管理平台的完整性。

items.reason_en: Session fixation vulnerability in IBM Security Verify Directory permits attackers to hijack authenticated administrative sessions. This bypasses identity verification mechanisms in critical IAM systems.
items.reason_zh: IBM Security Verify Directory 存在会话固定漏洞，允许攻击者劫持已认证的管理员会话。此漏洞绕过了关键身份与访问管理系统中的身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: A double-fetch bug in Red Hat DPDK vhost-crypto allows malicious guests to trigger out-of-bounds host memory access. This guest-to-host escape flaw compromises cloud hypervisor stability and security.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat DPDK vhost-crypto 中存在双重获取漏洞，允许恶意客户机触发越界的主机内存访问。此客户机到宿主机的逃逸缺陷会破坏云虚拟化程序（Hypervisor）的稳定性和安全性。

items.reason_en: Tenda AC19 router firmware contains a heap-based buffer overflow in parent control settings, allowing remote attackers to achieve complete device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Tenda AC19 路由器固件的家长控制设置中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者实现设备的完全接管。

items.reason_en: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE router suffers from a buffer overflow in WAN configuration CGI scripts, enabling remote exploitation to execute arbitrary commands.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 路由器的 WAN 配置 CGI 脚本存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可被远程利用以执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: FreeSWITCH uses a peer-controlled FEC entry count directly to fill fixed-size arrays, risking heap corruption and denial of service in software-defined telecom deployments.
items.reason_zh: FreeSWITCH 直接使用对等方控制的 FEC 条目计数来填充固定大小数组，在软件定义电信部署中可能导致堆损坏和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Ettercap's telnet dissector contains a stack buffer underwrite triggered by excessive backspaces, allowing network-adjacent attackers to crash or hijack traffic analysis processes.
items.reason_zh: Ettercap 的 telnet 协议解析器存在栈缓冲区下溢漏洞，由过多的退格符触发，允许网络邻近攻击者使流量分析进程崩溃或遭劫持。

items.reason_en: Known exploited password authentication bypass in OpenSSH with musl libc misinterprets hash strings, allowing unauthorized access for specific account configurations.
items.reason_zh: 使用 musl libc 的 OpenSSH 存在已知被利用的密码认证绕过漏洞，该漏洞错误解析哈希字符串，导致特定账户配置可被未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Known exploited SIP MESSAGE parsing flaw in FreeSWITCH splits To headers incorrectly, impacting telecom stack stability and security.
items.reason_zh: FreeSWITCH 存在已知被利用的 SIP MESSAGE 解析缺陷，会错误拆分 To 头字段，影响电信协议栈的稳定性和安全性。

items.reason_en: Reflected XSS in IBM QRadar triggers when authenticated users click crafted URLs, risking session hijacking within the SIEM interface.
items.reason_zh: IBM QRadar 存在反射型跨站脚本漏洞，当已认证用户点击构造的 URL 时触发，可能导致安全管理平台界面内的会话被劫持。

items.reason_en: Local authenticated attackers can write or overwrite arbitrary files with elevated privileges on HPE Networking Fabric Composer's underlying operating system.
items.reason_zh: 本地已认证攻击者可在 HPE Networking Fabric Composer 的底层操作系统上以高权限写入或覆盖任意文件。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in HPE Fabric Composer API allows adjacent attackers to circumvent controls under specific preconditions, exposing management services.
items.reason_zh: HPE Fabric Composer API 存在认证绕过漏洞，允许相邻攻击者在满足特定前置条件时规避控制措施，从而暴露管理服务。

items.reason_en: Accepting inbound ICE connectivity checks without cryptographic validation enables man-in-the-middle attacks against VoIP and telecom infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 在不进行密码学验证的情况下接受入站 ICE 连接检查，会导致针对语音通信和电信基础设施的中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing integrity verification in the networking fabric API allows low-privileged attackers to escalate privileges and gain elevated system access.
items.reason_zh: 网络架构 API 缺少完整性验证，允许低权限攻击者提升权限并获得高系统访问权。

items.reason_en: Oversized Subject Alternative Names cause certificate validation to fall back to Common Name checks, allowing attackers to bypass strict certificate pinning on network appliances.
items.reason_zh: 过长的主题备用名称会导致证书验证回退到通用名称检查，使攻击者能够绕过网络设备上的严格证书固定策略。

items.reason_en: Non-administrator users in ntopng can trigger vulnerability scans on arbitrary hosts, potentially exposing sensitive network infrastructure details.
items.reason_zh: ntopng 中的非管理员用户可对任意主机触发漏洞扫描，可能暴露敏感的网络基础设施详情。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Control Web Panel's protected directory module executes arbitrary commands via unsanitized file POST parameters. This grants remote attackers full host control over server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Control Web Panel 的受保护目录模块存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，可通过未过滤的文件 POST 参数执行任意命令。此漏洞赋予远程攻击者对服务器基础设施的完全主机控制权。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Control Web Panel concatenates unsanitized module names directly into include paths. Attackers can load arbitrary local PHP files, bypassing web panel security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Control Web Panel 存在路径遍历漏洞，会将未过滤的模块名直接拼接至包含路径中。攻击者可加载任意本地 PHP 文件，从而绕过 Web 面板的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Root-level OS command injection in Control Web Panel's loopback password change route runs unescaped user input through a shell. This compromises network management interfaces with immediate privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Control Web Panel 的回环密码更改路由存在根级别操作系统命令注入漏洞，会将未转义的用户输入直接交由 Shell 执行。此漏洞会立即导致提权，危及网络管理接口。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds read in libslirp's ICMP error forwarding occurs when packet length is not clamped to buffer size. This affects virtualized network stacks in containers and hypervisors, risking information leakage.
items.reason_zh: libslirp 的 ICMP 错误转发功能在包长度未限制为缓冲区大小时会发生堆越界读取。此漏洞影响容器和虚拟化程序中的虚拟网络协议栈，存在信息泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in HPE Networking Fabric Composer allows unauthenticated access to sensitive traffic metadata under certain conditions. This weakens software-defined networking controller security.
items.reason_zh: HPE Networking Fabric Composer 存在证书验证不当漏洞，在特定条件下允许未认证访问敏感流量元数据。此漏洞削弱了软件定义网络控制器的安全性。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded credentials in HPE Networking Fabric Composer enable unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrative control. This flaw severely weakens network management infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: HPE Networking Fabric Composer 存在硬编码凭据漏洞，允许未认证的远程攻击者获取管理员控制权。此缺陷严重削弱了网络管理基础设施的安全性。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in the HNAP handler of D-Link routers allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability affects widely deployed consumer and small business networking equipment.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 路由器的 HNAP 处理程序存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码。该漏洞影响了广泛部署的消费级和中小企业网络设备。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in the web management interface of Intelbras switches permits unauthorized network configuration changes. Attackers can bypass security controls to reconfigure enterprise LAN infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Intelbras 交换机的 Web 管理界面存在认证不当漏洞，允许未经授权的网络配置更改。攻击者可绕过安全控制以重新配置企业局域网基础设施。

items.reason_en: INDOTALENT WHMS ships with default administrator credentials, granting immediate full administrative access to any unpatched deployment without authentication.
items.reason_zh: INDOTALENT WHMS 默认包含管理员凭据，任何未打补丁的部署均可在无需身份验证的情况下立即获得完全的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: CraftCMS front-end search functionality concatenates unsanitized input into MySQL queries, enabling unauthenticated stacked SQL injection and full database compromise.
items.reason_zh: CraftCMS 前端搜索功能将未清理的输入直接拼接至 MySQL 查询语句中，可导致未经身份验证的堆叠式 SQL 注入及数据库完全失陷。

items.reason_en: SuiteCRM's Studio Dropdown Editor writes decoded HTML entities directly into PHP language files, allowing authenticated users to inject and execute arbitrary server-side code.
items.reason_zh: SuiteCRM 的 Studio 下拉编辑器将解码后的 HTML 实体直接写入 PHP 语言文件，使得经过身份验证的用户能够注入并执行任意服务端代码。

items.reason_en: GLPI login flows can be manipulated via crafted URLs to bypass one-time-password verification, effectively defeating two-factor authentication for enterprise asset management.
items.reason_zh: 攻击者可通过构造的 URL 操纵 GLPI 登录流程以绕过一次性密码验证，从而有效规避企业资产管理系统的双因素认证机制。

items.reason_en: Agenta workflow editor permits workspace members to redirect invocations via SSRF, capturing attached secret-resolve tokens to exfiltrate cloud provider credentials.
items.reason_zh: Agenta 工作流编辑器允许工作区成员利用 SSRF 重定向调用请求，捕获附带的安全令牌解析凭证，进而泄露云服务提供商的凭据。

items.reason_en: Attacker-influenced replacement text evaluates as Perl code in SEPPmail, enabling unauthenticated remote command execution in mail-processing workers.
items.reason_zh: 在 SEPPmail 中，受攻击者控制的替换文本会被当作 Perl 代码执行，从而导致邮件处理进程出现未经身份验证的远程命令执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: Missing ImageMagick security policies in Ruby on Rails ActiveStorage allow arbitrary file read/write operations during image attachment processing.
items.reason_zh: Ruby on Rails ActiveStorage 缺失 ImageMagick 安全策略配置，导致在处理图片附件时可执行任意文件读写操作。

items.reason_en: Lack of device node validation during tar extraction in pyLoad enables attackers to create special files or overwrite arbitrary system paths.
items.reason_zh: pyLoad 在执行 tar 解压时未对设备节点进行验证，攻击者可借此创建特殊文件或直接覆盖任意系统路径。

items.reason_en: Insecure direct object references in TrailBase allow authenticated users to manipulate object-store IDs without ownership validation, accessing other users' files.
items.reason_zh: TrailBase 存在不安全的直接对象引用漏洞，允许经过身份验证的用户在未经验证所有权的情况下篡改对象存储 ID，从而访问其他用户的文件。

items.reason_en: Missing runtime primitive-type validation in GraphQL Tools mergeIncrementalResult helper enables prototype pollution or unexpected behavior in schema stitching.
items.reason_zh: GraphQL Tools 的 mergeIncrementalResult 辅助函数缺失运行时的基础类型验证，可能导致原型链污染或在模式拼接过程中产生异常行为。

items.reason_en: Multitenancy permission bypass allows unauthorized creation and modification of resources across tenants, severely compromising SaaS authentication platforms.
items.reason_zh: 多租户权限绕过漏洞允许跨租户未经授权地创建和修改资源，严重危及 SaaS 身份认证平台的安全。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload via client-controlled permission parameters enables arbitrary file placement on the server, directly leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 通过客户端可控的权限参数实现无限制的文件上传，可在服务器上任意放置文件，直接导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Password reset poisoning via gRPC metadata allows attackers to control the hosted domain in reset emails, facilitating account takeover through phishing links.
items.reason_zh: 利用 gRPC 元数据实施密码重置投毒攻击，可使攻击者控制重置邮件中的目标域名，进而通过钓鱼链接劫持用户账户。

items.reason_en: Multipart parser deviation from RFC 2231 precedence allows attackers to bypass Content-Disposition restrictions, potentially uploading malicious scripts past WAF defenses.
items.reason_zh: 多部分表单解析器未遵循 RFC 2231 的优先级规则，导致攻击者可绕过 Content-Disposition 限制，成功绕过 WAF 防御上传恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Keycloak's multi-organization identity-first login flow contains flaws that allow attackers to manipulate authentication contexts across organizations.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak 的多组织先身份后登录流程存在缺陷，允许攻击者跨组织篡改身份验证上下文。

items.reason_en: Absence of rate limiting on password reset endpoints in Databasus allows unauthenticated brute-force attacks against user accounts.
items.reason_zh: Databasus 的密码重置接口未实施速率限制，攻击者可对未授权状态下的用户账户发起暴力破解攻击。

items.reason_en: Authenticated non-student users in RosarioSIS can extract administrator passwords via crafted SQL payloads in student summary reports.
items.reason_zh: RosarioSIS 中经过身份验证的非学生用户可利用学生汇总报告中的构造 SQL 载荷，提取管理员密码。

items.reason_en: External control of configuration settings in MediaWiki's CentralAuth extension enables code injection attacks.
items.reason_zh: MediaWiki 的 CentralAuth 扩展存在外部控制配置项的缺陷，可导致代码注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled HTTP/1.1 connections in the Cowboy web server exhaust process memory, enabling remote denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Cowboy Web 服务器未对 HTTP/1.1 连接进行限流控制，大量并发连接会耗尽进程内存，从而导致远程拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP code execution due to missing capability and nonce checks in a widely used WordPress plugin. This flaw directly compromises site integrity and allows full server takeover.
items.reason_zh: 某广泛使用的 WordPress 插件因缺失能力校验与 Nonce 验证，导致未经身份验证的 PHP 代码执行。该漏洞直接破坏网站完整性，并可导致服务器被完全接管。

items.reason_en: SAML authentication bypass in OpenAM accepts unsigned assertions when WantAssertionsSigned is false. Attackers can forge assertions to hijack user sessions and bypass enterprise identity controls.
items.reason_zh: OpenAM 的 SAML 认证绕过漏洞会在 WantAssertionsSigned 为 false 时接受未签名的断言。攻击者可伪造断言以劫持用户会话并绕过企业身份管控。

items.reason_en: JWT authentication bypass in python-jose occurs because the library accepts zero-length HMAC secrets. This undermines token verification across countless web APIs and microservices.
items.reason_zh: python-jose 库因接受零长度 HMAC 密钥而导致 JWT 认证绕过，严重削弱了海量 Web API 与微服务的 Token 验证安全性。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in OpenEMR allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger internal HTTP requests via an unvalidated OAuth2 JWKS URI. This enables lateral movement within healthcare network segments.
items.reason_zh: OpenEMR 存在服务端请求伪造漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可通过未经验证的 OAuth2 JWKS URI 触发内部 HTTP 请求，进而在医疗网络网段内实现横向移动。

items.reason_en: Cross-site request forgery in AB Download Manager enables arbitrary file writes through an unauthenticated browser-integration API. Attackers can deploy web shells or overwrite critical application files.
items.reason_zh: AB Download Manager 存在跨站请求伪造漏洞，攻击者可通过未经身份验证的浏览器集成 API 实现任意文件写入，进而部署 Webshell 或覆盖关键应用文件。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated deserialization of untrusted data in rConfig allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via Redis queues. This flaw poses a direct threat to network configuration management web portals.
items.reason_zh: rConfig 存在未经身份验证的反序列化漏洞，攻击者可利用不可信数据通过 Redis 队列执行任意代码，对网络设备配置管理 Web 门户构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Workflow permission bypass in Liferay Portal enables remote non-authenticated users to modify critical workflow definitions. The vulnerability undermines content management system access controls.
items.reason_zh: Liferay Portal 的工作流权限绕过漏洞允许远程未授权用户修改关键工作流定义，严重破坏了内容管理系统的访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Eval-based code execution in Eclipse otterdog occurs when GitHub webhook secrets are unset, allowing unauthenticated RCE. This impacts developer tools and CI/CD integration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 当未配置 GitHub Webhook 密钥时，Eclipse otterdog 会触发基于 eval 的代码执行，导致未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重影响开发者工具及 CI/CD 集成平台。

items.reason_en: RESTEasy CORS misconfiguration reflects the Origin header with credentials enabled, facilitating cross-site request forgery attacks. Developers must update frameworks to prevent credential leakage across domains.
items.reason_zh: RESTEasy 的 CORS 配置错误导致在启用凭据的情况下反射 Origin 请求头，助长跨站请求伪造攻击。开发者需升级框架以防止跨域凭据泄露。

items.reason_en: Mongoose MongoDB driver ignores configured sanitizeFilter protections when passing attacker-controlled filters, enabling NoSQL injection and unauthorized data manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Mongoose MongoDB 驱动在传入攻击者可控的过滤条件时，会忽略配置的 sanitizeFilter 防护机制，从而导致 NoSQL 注入及未授权的数据篡改。

items.reason_en: Pocket ID binds email verification tokens only to user identifiers rather than specific client sessions, allowing token reuse across different applications to bypass account recovery controls.
items.reason_zh: Pocket ID 仅将邮箱验证令牌绑定至用户标识符而非特定客户端会话，导致令牌可在不同应用间复用，从而绕过账户恢复控制机制。

items.reason_en: Keycloak automatically links external federated identities to local accounts based solely on matching email addresses, enabling account takeover attacks via spoofed identity providers.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak仅基于匹配的电子邮件地址自动将外部联合身份与本地账户关联，攻击者可通过伪造的身份提供商实施账户接管攻击。

items.reason_en: MIT Kerberos 5 fails to free decoded arguments on certain GSSAPI error paths, allowing remote attackers to exhaust kadmind memory and cause denial of service.
items.reason_zh: MIT Kerberos 5在某些GSSAPI错误路径下未能释放已解码的参数，允许远程攻击者耗尽kadmind内存并导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated crafted input in IBM Concert incorporates into OS commands, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands with host privileges.
items.reason_zh: IBM Concert中未经验证的构造输入会被拼接到操作系统命令中，使远程攻击者能够以主机权限执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Sonatype Nexus Pro fails to check local account status during SAML/OAuth2 login, allowing disabled or locked accounts to regain access via identity providers.
items.reason_zh: Sonatype Nexus Pro在SAML/OAuth2登录期间未检查本地账户状态，导致被禁用或锁定的账户可通过身份提供商恢复访问权限。

items.reason_en: XML External Entity injection in IBM MQ allows remote attackers to read local files or perform SSRF when processing XML data.
items.reason_zh: IBM MQ存在XML外部实体注入漏洞，攻击者在处理XML数据时可读取本地文件或发起SSRF攻击。

items.reason_en: MIT Kerberos 5 fails to free RPC reply verifiers between retries, causing memory leaks and denial of service in GSS-RPC client programs.
items.reason_zh: MIT Kerberos 5在重试间隔未能释放RPC响应验证器，导致GSS-RPC客户端程序出现内存泄漏和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Improper sensitivity classification in WildFly Core handlers allows restricted administrators to exfiltrate sensitive configuration files and credentials.
items.reason_zh: WildFly Core处理器中的敏感度分类不当，允许受限管理员外泄敏感配置文件和凭据。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the integration server allows remote attackers to circumvent security controls and access restricted enterprise messaging functions.
items.reason_zh: 集成服务器存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许远程攻击者规避安全控制并访问受限的企业消息传递功能。

items.reason_en: Improper Content Security Policy configuration enables remote attackers to bypass security restrictions, potentially leading to data exfiltration or session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: 内容安全策略（CSP）配置不当使远程攻击者能够绕过安全限制，可能导致数据外泄或会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Decompression routine accepts zlib streams without verifying output length equality, risking memory corruption and potential denial-of-service in database proxies.
items.reason_zh: 解压缩例程接受zlib流时未验证输出长度是否一致，可能在数据库代理中引发内存损坏及潜在的拒绝服务风险。

items.reason_en: Authenticated attackers can execute arbitrary code on IBM MQ consumers through insecure deserialization of ObjectMessages.
items.reason_zh: 认证攻击者可通过IBM MQ消费者中对ObjectMessages的不安全反序列化执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Commit object parsing divergence in Dulwich affects Poetry's default dependency resolution, potentially compromising supply chain integrity.
items.reason_zh: Dulwich中提交对象解析的差异会影响Poetry的默认依赖解析，可能破坏供应链完整性。

items.reason_en: Proxy endpoint manipulation in DataLinkDC exposes internal Flink URLs, risking leakage of sensitive job configurations and data.
items.reason_zh: DataLinkDC中的代理端点操纵会暴露内部Flink URL，导致敏感作业配置和数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in SurrealDB binds MCP BoundSubject fingerprints to access method names instead of per-user identities. Low-privilege token holders can impersonate victims sharing the same access method.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB的身份验证机制存在缺陷，将MCP BoundSubject指纹绑定到访问方法名称而非用户个体标识。低权限令牌持有者可冒充共享相同访问方法的受害者。

items.reason_en: Zone file parser in Hickory DNS panics when processing oversized single tokens, causing service disruption. This impacts modern Rust-based DNS resolvers deployed in enterprise and ISP environments.
items.reason_zh: Hickory DNS的区域文件解析器在处理超大单令牌时会发生panic（崩溃），导致服务中断。该问题影响部署于企业和ISP环境的现代Rust语言DNS解析器。

items.reason_en: Query amplification vulnerability in Hickory DNS recursive resolver mishandles cyclic sibling referrals lacking glue records. Attackers can leverage this to amplify DNS traffic for reflection attacks.
items.reason_zh: Hickory DNS递归解析器存在查询放大漏洞，在处理缺乏粘合记录的循环兄弟节点转发时处理不当。攻击者可利用此漏洞放大DNS流量以实施反射攻击。

items.reason_en: Unbounded iteration over out-of-bailiwick NS targets in Hickory DNS forces excessive A and AAAA lookups without work budgets. This causes severe resolver resource exhaustion and denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Hickory DNS对非管辖域NS目标进行无界迭代，且未设置工作量预算，导致过度执行A和AAAA记录查询。这会引发严重的解析器资源耗尽和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Signed/unsigned integer conversion error in GStreamer's H.264 RTP depayloader causes remaining-length counter underflow. This triggers crashes or memory corruption in multimedia streaming pipelines.
items.reason_zh: GStreamer的H.264 RTP去包器中存在有符号/无符号整数转换错误，导致剩余长度计数器下溢。这将触发多媒体流媒体管道的崩溃或内存损坏。

items.reason_en: JWT filter evaluation flaw in Neo4j GraphQL allows attackers holding valid tokens to bypass authorization checks. This undermines database query security in graph-based application architectures.
items.reason_zh: Neo4j GraphQL的JWT过滤器评估存在缺陷，允许持有有效令牌的攻击者绕过授权检查。这破坏了基于图的应用架构中的数据库查询安全性。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in DataLinkDC Dinky's SQL gateway endpoint enables internal network reconnaissance and data exfiltration. The vulnerability exposes backend database connectivity layers to abuse.
items.reason_zh: DataLinkDC Dinky的SQL网关端点存在服务端请求伪造漏洞，可被用于内网探测和数据外泄。该漏洞使后端数据库连接层面临滥用风险。

items.reason_en: Ghostscript bypasses -dSAFER sandbox restrictions by exploiting type errors in .putgstringcopy, allowing crafted PostScript or PDF documents to execute privileged operations.
items.reason_zh: Ghostscript通过利用.putgstringcopy中的类型错误绕过了-dSAFER沙箱限制，使构造的PostScript或PDF文档得以执行特权操作。

items.reason_en: PyMoDAQ scientific desktop application deserializes untrusted data and executes eval injection through opened files, permitting arbitrary code execution on researcher workstations.
items.reason_zh: PyMoDAQ科学桌面应用程序反序列化不受信任的数据，并通过打开的文件执行eval注入，允许在研究人员工作站上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: musl libc experiences multiple integer overflows during regular expression compilation, leading to incorrect allocation sizes and out-of-bounds heap writes in downstream applications.
items.reason_zh: musl libc在正则表达式编译过程中发生多次整数溢出，导致分配大小计算错误，并在下游应用中引发堆越界写入。

items.reason_en: OpenBMB Internet of Agents improperly handles message handler access controls, allowing manipulation of communication IDs to bypass intended isolation between agent instances.
items.reason_zh: OpenBMB Internet of Agents对消息处理器访问控制的处理不当，允许通过操纵通信ID来绕过代理实例间预期的隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Caller-controlled search patterns are injected directly into shell commands in augment-vir without sanitization, enabling command injection vulnerabilities.
items.reason_zh: augment-vir未对调用方控制的搜索模式进行清理，直接将其拼接到Shell命令中，从而导致命令注入漏洞。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in FFmpeg's APAC decoder triggered by crafted bitstreams can corrupt memory and crash media processing applications.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg的APAC解码器在处理构造的码流时会触发堆越界写入，导致内存损坏及媒体处理应用崩溃。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in FFmpeg's ProRes encoder miscalculates frame bounds using 32-bit arithmetic, leading to heap corruption on large video resolutions.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg的ProRes编码器在使用32位算术运算计算帧边界时发生整数溢出，在大分辨率视频下会导致堆损坏。

items.reason_en: Encoder property manipulation in mikefarah/yq leads to output escaping issues, potentially disrupting downstream structured data processing workflows.
items.reason_zh: mikefarah/yq中的编码器属性操纵会导致输出转义问题，可能破坏下游结构化数据处理工作流。

items.reason_en: Weak shell operator filtering in sandbox configurations allows attackers to bypass restrictions and execute arbitrary commands within AI agent workspaces.
items.reason_zh: 沙箱配置中的Shell运算符过滤机制薄弱，允许攻击者绕过限制并在AI代理工作区中执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Accepting unvalidated required-version strings from project files enables supply chain attacks where malicious actors force compromised formatter versions via pull requests.
items.reason_zh: 接受项目文件中未经验证的required-version字符串会引发供应链攻击，恶意攻击者可通过拉取请求强制引入已被篡改的格式化器版本。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds stack write in the WebAssembly polling wrapper allows unauthenticated peers to corrupt memory and potentially achieve remote code execution in isolated runtimes.
items.reason_zh: WebAssembly轮询封装器中的越界栈写入漏洞允许未认证的对等节点破坏内存，并可能在隔离的运行时环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Malicious SNI callbacks in Python TLS clients trigger use-after-free conditions, crashing servers and impacting downstream applications.
items.reason_zh: Python TLS客户端中的恶意SNI回调会触发释放后使用（UAF）条件，导致服务器崩溃并影响下游应用。

items.reason_en: Incorrect Merkle tree padding logic in bitcoinjs-lib breaks block-root verification, potentially disrupting Bitcoin node synchronization.
items.reason_zh: bitcoinjs-lib中错误的默克尔树填充逻辑会破坏区块根验证，可能导致比特币节点同步中断。

items.reason_en: User-controlled task names passed directly to storage classes in Yeti enable path traversal attacks, risking file system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Yeti中将用户可控的任务名称直接传递给存储类可引发路径遍历攻击，存在文件系统被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: The Elo AST API interpolates untyped values into code generators without validation, creating risks for code injection across multiple languages.
items.reason_zh: Elo AST API在未经验证的情况下将无类型值插值至代码生成器中，导致跨多种语言的代码注入风险。

items.reason_en: Quadratic work in Zebra's mempool coinbase-maturity check allows peers to repeatedly send transactions with many transparent inputs. This creates blockchain network congestion and delays transaction processing.
items.reason_zh: Zebra内存池的coinbase成熟度检查存在二次复杂度计算问题，允许对等节点反复发送包含大量透明输入的交易。这将导致区块链网络拥塞并延迟交易处理。

items.reason_en: Denial of service in Zebra zebrad stalls checkpoint sync by cancelling verifier rewind after failed commits. Forged blocks with altered authorizing data can permanently disrupt node synchronization.
items.reason_zh: Zebra zebrad中的拒绝服务漏洞通过取消验证器回退来阻碍检查点同步。带有篡改授权数据的伪造区块可能永久破坏节点同步。

items.reason_en: SAML assertion override in Tracecat renders signed assertion flags empty, disabling bot protection defaults. This compromises security automation platform integrity and workflow enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Tracecat中的SAML断言覆盖漏洞会使签名断言标志变为空，从而禁用机器人防护默认设置。这破坏了安全自动化平台的完整性及工作流强制执行机制。

items.reason_en: Denial of service in SvelteJS devalue causes CPU amplification when sparse arrays are passed to uneval. Synchronous work proportional to declared array length blocks event loops in client applications.
items.reason_zh: SvelteJS devalue中的拒绝服务漏洞在将稀疏数组传递给uneval时会引发CPU资源消耗放大。与声明数组长度成正比的同步工作会阻塞客户端应用程序的事件循环。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in NEC WebSAM WinShare allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. This critically impacts IT monitoring and security software deployments.
items.reason_zh: NEC WebSAM WinShare中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者以SYSTEM权限执行任意代码。该漏洞严重影响IT监控与安全软件的部署。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in IBM Qiskit SDK permits local attackers to execute arbitrary code. The flaw affects quantum computing development environments and research toolchains.
items.reason_zh: IBM Qiskit SDK中对不信任数据进行反序列化允许本地攻击者执行任意代码。该缺陷影响量子计算开发环境及研究工具链。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in HuggingFace finetrainers impacts machine learning model indexing workflows. Researchers and developers using this library face risks of malicious payload execution during model loading.
items.reason_zh: HuggingFace finetrainers中的代码注入漏洞会影响机器学习模型索引工作流。使用该库的研究人员和开发者在模型加载时面临恶意载荷执行的风险。

items.reason_en: CPU entry area mapping flaw in Red Hat Linux kernels risks unauthorized memory access and potential information disclosure. This architectural vulnerability affects host and virtualized environments running affected kernel versions.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Linux内核中的CPU入口区映射缺陷可能导致未授权内存访问和信息泄露。该架构级漏洞影响运行受影响内核版本的主机及虚拟化环境。
